display.explanation: Social Services Sunday recognises people and organisations caring for others in our communities, and encourages thanksgiving and practical support for their work.
display.prompt: Pray for those receiving support and for the people who serve them through social services.

sentences.label: Sentence
sentences.text: Let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an everflowing stream.

sentences.label: Post-communion sentence
sentences.text: Jesus said, “I have set you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.”

collects.text:
God of compassion, you thirst for justice;
give to all who follow Christ
the vision of your kingdom
and the gifts of your Spirit
to work for its coming;
through the one who alone satisfies all our thirst,
Jesus Christ our Saviour.
